player_prompt.intro:
A yi walla Mastermind.
A yi soodi koodu nde {code_length} hannde dogo, kala hannde daga 1 haa {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Caggal a yi jokkire, a yi walla jokkire maa a yi walla a diffeere nde: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Caggal kala jokkire, a yi heɓiimaari a yi diffeere a nde tatiire e innde baŋŋe e konkon peggii.
Tatiire baŋŋe ina wiyi hannde heɓiimaari a yi diffeere a nde heɓiimaari, amma konkon peggii ina wiyi hannde heɓiimaari a yi diffeere a nde poti.
A yi {max_turns} lokkere a yi soodi koodu nde.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A yi jawabi maa baawo caɗeeji ɗum waɗiɗi ɓaawo ɓoggol ɗum waɗiɗi.
invalid_move.not_integers: Ko windi fuu haani laato intejairji je ɗon na.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: A ɗon tammi {guess}. To a foondi feere, foonda nde woore.

game_action.feedback: An gabatar da [{guess}]. Bayanin karin bayani: {black_pegs} kututtuwa baƙi, {white_pegs} kututtuwa fari.

outcome.win: A yi karyi koodu nde, a yi heɓiimaari {black_pegs} hannde daga {code_length} peggii a nde heɓiimaari
outcome.turn_limit: Limgal waylugo yotti. A footi taƴa {percent} % limɗe je ɗon wooɗi.
